_readMeFirst: v0.18.0 same-origin Worker hosting plus PR #13 diagnostics, PR #14 browser bootstrap changes and PR #15 cached-client compatibility are merged and deployed. Production activation still fails at initial secure-session bootstrap. PR #16 removes APP_ORIGIN as a browser-origin authority and uses the actual Worker request origin for same-origin browser authentication.
